blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.
blocks.zh: 互动世界模型的最近进展使得有可能从行动投入中产生可控制、能动的环境。 然而,目前的模型在大约推出一分钟之后仍难以保持一致性,这一局限性不在于模型能力,而在于缺乏长期的培训数据。 现有的游戏游戏视频数据集一般由十秒以下的片段组成,并有描述整段片段的字幕用粗糙而无区别的文字来描述,这不足以控制长视距生成. 我们用GameVerse来解决这个问题,GameVerse是一个小尺度的游戏游戏游戏视频数据集,目的为长视互动世界建模. GameVerse 包含 69.7K相隔1655小时和相距34.96万帧的剪辑跨越了不同的第一人称和第三人称游戏游戏,包括1,358小时的连续两分钟序列,这个数量级比之前的数据集要长. 剪贴经过一个统一的管道,包括符合场景的分块、质量过滤、相机进行估计以及基于事件的说明。 每个片段都配有一段时间稳定的相机轨迹,该轨迹在分分钟之间保持连贯,并配有将静态场景背景与动态前地事件区分开来并符合事件边界而非固定的时间窗口的字幕. 综合分析显示,GameVerse在规模,多样性和注释质量上超过了现有的公共数据集. 实验进一步证明,关于GameVerse的培训大大扩展了互动世界模型的时间范围.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive world models Bruce et al. (2024) ; Valevski et al. (2025) ; Xiao et al. (2025) aim to learn controllable, dynamic environments that can be rolled out from action and camera inputs, a capability central to embodied decision-making, simulation, and game-style content generation. Recent gameplay-oriented systems such as GameGen-X Che et al. (2025) , Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) , Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) , and HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld (2025) demonstrate compelling short-horizon controllability, yet they share a striking ceiling: rollouts collapse into drift, identity loss, and scene incoherence after roughly one minute of generation. We argue that this ceiling is, first and foremost, a data problem rather than a model-capacity problem. The training corpora behind these systems consist almost entirely of clips shorter than ten seconds, paired with whole-clip captions that conflate static context with dynamic events. Such data fundamentally cannot supervise minute-scale temporal coherence, fine-grained controllability, or event-level semantics, no matter how large the model.
blocks.zh: 交互式世界模式 Bruce et al. (2024); Valevski et al. (2025); Xiao et al. (2025) 旨在学习可控,动态的环境,这些环境可以从动作和相机输入中展开,这种能力是体现决策,模拟,游戏风格内容生成的核心. 近期的游戏游戏导向系统如GameGen-X Che等人(2025年),Matrix-Game Zhang等人(2025年),Hunyuan-GameCraft Li等人(2025年a年),HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld(2025年)等,都表现出令人惊叹的短视可控性,然而它们却有着惊人的天花板:在大约一分钟的一代后,摇身成漂流,失去身份,场景不一致. 我们认为,这一上限首先是一个数据问题,而不是一个模型能力问题。 这些系统背后的训练团几乎完全由短于10秒的片段组成,配对的是将静态上下文与动态事件混为一谈的全clip字幕. 这些数据根本上无法监督分钟时间一致性、精细的可控性或事件层面的语义,无论模型有多大。

blocks.en: This limitation is visible across recent gameplay and exploration datasets, which exhibit a consistent pattern of single-axis optimization (Table 1 ). Sekai Li et al. (2025c) ; He et al. (2026) provides large-scale exploration video but lacks dense interactions, validated camera trajectories, and structured semantics. Matrix-Game and HY-World 1.5 expose engine-level camera poses but cap continuous footage at short windows. GameGen-X and Hunyuan-GameCraft support action-conditioned interaction but lack reliable trajectories and event-aligned captions. None of them simultaneously provides minute-scale continuous footage, validated frame-level camera trajectories, dense first- and third-person interaction coverage, and multi-granular event-aligned semantic annotations. So long as these four signals remain fragmented across separate datasets, any model trained on a single source inherits its blind spot.
blocks.zh: 这一限制在近期的游戏玩法和探索数据集中可见,这些数据集表现出一致的单轴优化模式(表1). Sekai Li等人(2025c); He等人(2026年)提供大规模探索视频,但缺乏密集的相互作用,验证的相机轨迹,以及结构化的语义. Matrix-Game和HY-World 1.5曝光引擎级相机的姿势,但短窗的盖连续镜头. 游戏 Gen-X和Hunyuan-GameCraft支持有动作条件的交互,但缺乏可靠的轨迹和事件匹配的字幕. 没有一个同时提供分钟尺度的连续镜头,经过验证的帧级相机轨迹,密集的第一人称和第三人称交互覆盖,以及多角事件对齐的语义说明. 只要这四个信号在不同的数据集之间仍然支离破碎,任何在单一来源上受过训练的模型都会继承其盲点.

blocks.en: We close this gap with GameVerse , a minute-scale gameplay dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. Curated from 11,002 source videos at 1080p and 30–60 FPS through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, multi-stage quality filtering, ViPE-based Huang et al. (2025) pose estimation with trajectory validation, and event-aligned multi-granular captioning, GameVerse delivers 69.7K clips , 1,655 hours , and 349.6M frames , including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences —roughly an order of magnitude longer than any prior gameplay or exploration dataset. Every clip is paired with a temporally stable frame-level camera trajectory that survives explicit jump-, jitter-, and drift-filtering; a four-level structured caption ( global static , local static , dynamic events , agent actions ) that disentangles scene context from foreground change; and dense behavior coverage across first- and third-person perspectives, spanning exploration, combat, walking, driving, climbing, and complex object interaction. To our knowledge, GameVerse is the first dataset to ship these four signals jointly under a single quality bar, and fine-tuning a strong video generator on it improves VBench Huang et al. (2024) temporal-consistency and visual quality, and WorldScore Duan et al. (2025) content alignment and 3D consistency, over gameplay-domain baselines on a 30-second benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们用GameVerse来填补这一空白,GameVerse是一个为长视互动世界建模而设计的微量游戏游戏数据集。 从1080p和30-60 FPS的11 002个源视频中,通过统一的场景一致的分区、多阶段质量过滤、基于VIPE的Huang等人(2025年)提出轨迹验证估计,以及事件对齐的多角字幕,GameVerse提供了69.7K剪辑、1 655小时和349.6M帧,包括1 358小时连续两分钟的测序——大概比以往任何游戏或探索数据集的量级要长。 每个片段配对时空稳定的帧级相机轨迹,可存活于明显的跳跃,抖动,漂移的滤波;四级结构化字幕(全球静态,局部静态,动态事件,代理动作),能将场景背景与前地变化分开;以及密集的行为覆盖第一和第三人称视角,横跨探索,战斗,步行,驾驶,攀登,以及复杂的物体互动. 据我们所知,GameVerse是第一个在单一质量栏下联合运送这四个信号的数据集,并且对其上一个强大的视频生成器进行了微调,提高了V Bench Huang et al. (2024)时间一致性和视觉质量,以及WorldScore Duan et al. (2025)内容一致和3D一致性,超过30秒基准的游戏领域基线.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • The largest minute-scale gameplay dataset to date. 69.7K clips, 1,655 hours, and 349.6M frames, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences—roughly an order of magnitude longer than existing gameplay corpora and the first to directly supervise the minute-scale rollout regime where current interactive world models fail. • A unified construction pipeline with reliable camera trajectories. Scene-consistent segmentation that combines hard-cut detection with CLIP-based gradual-transition detection, multi-stage visual / content / temporal quality filtering, and ViPE-based pose estimation with explicit jump-, jitter-, and drift-filtering—delivering temporally stable trajectories at minute scale, where most prior datasets either omit poses or expose noisy ones. • A multi-granular event-aligned caption schema. A four-level structured annotation ( global static , local static , dynamic events , agent actions ) that disentangles environment context from controllable behavior and supports hierarchical conditioning—replacing the single-line whole-clip captions that dominate prior gameplay data. • Empirical validation on long-horizon generation. Training on GameVerse improves VBench temporal-consistency and visual-quality metrics and most WorldScore controllability metrics over gameplay-domain baselines on a held-out long-duration benchmark.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Interactive World Models and Gameplay Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 互动世界模型和游戏游戏数据集

blocks.en: Early work on interactive video generation established the methodological foundation but relied on closed, narrow training corpora. Genie Bruce et al. (2024) learns latent actions from an unreleased, curated 30K-hour platformer collection, leaving the community without a reusable substrate. GameNGen Valevski et al. (2025) and Oasis Decart et al. (2024) demonstrate that diffusion models can serve as real-time game engines, yet rely on a single game ( e.g . DOOM) or a closed Decart corpus, limiting cross-game generalization and broader scientific study. WorldMem Xiao et al. (2025) introduces an explicit memory module for long-term Minecraft simulation, showing that long-horizon coherence is methodologically tractable, but remains limited to a narrow evaluation domain without a transferable, large-scale gameplay dataset.
blocks.zh: 早期的交互式视频生成工作建立了方法基础,但依赖于封闭的,狭义的训练公司. Genie Bruce et al. (2024)从一个未发行,编译的30K小时平台器集中学习潜在动作,使得社区没有可重复使用的底物. GameNgen Valevski等人(2025)和Oasis Decart等人(2024)证明扩散模型可以作为实时游戏引擎,然而依赖于单游戏(例如. DOOM)或闭合的Decartabus,限制跨游戏泛化和更广泛的科学研究. WorldMem Xiao 等 (英语). (2025)为长期Minecraft模拟引入了明确的内存模块,显示长视距一致性在方法上是可牵引的,但仍局限于一个没有可转移的大型游戏游戏数据集的狭义评价领域.

blocks.en: More recent gameplay-oriented systems advance controllability with action and camera signals Team et al. (2026a) ; Yin et al. (2026) , but fall short on the long-horizon data axis. GameGen-X Che et al. (2025) is trained predominantly on gameplay clips of a few seconds, providing little supervision for minute-scale rollouts. The Matrix-Game family—the Minecraft-centered Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) and Matrix-Game 2.0 He et al. (2025) , and the recent Matrix-Game 3.0 Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team (2026) targeting long-horizon coherence via memory-augmented diffusion on an industrial-scale Unreal-Engine and AAA-game data engine—releases model weights and code but keeps its gameplay training corpora and Video-Pose-Action-Prompt quadruplet data proprietary , leaving no shared substrate for scaling, ablation, and reproducibility. Our work complements Matrix-Game 3.0: while it addresses the long-horizon problem from the model side through memory on a closed data engine, GameVerse addresses it from the data side with an openly released, multi-game, minute-scale corpus that any model can consume. Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) and HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld (2025) report strong qualitative results across diverse environments but rely on unreleased internal gameplay recordings; WorldPlay Sun et al. (2025) pursues real-time long-horizon generation under the same proprietary-data constraint, while VMem Li et al. (2025b) explores surfel-indexed memory but remains bound to a method-specific corpus. Across this landscape, the lack of a public, diverse, multi-game, minute-scale gameplay dataset remains the principal bottleneck, rather than model capacity.
blocks.zh: 更近期的以游戏为主的系统,以动作和相机信号推进可控性 Team等人(2026a); Yin et al. (2026),但是在长视数据轴上还不足. 游戏 Gen - X (英语). Che等人(2025年)主要接受几秒钟的游戏剧情片段的培训,为分钟级的推出提供很少的监督. Matrix-Game家族——Minecraft-center Matrix-Game Zhang等人(2025年)和Matrix-Game 2.0 He等人(2025年),以及最近Matrix-Game 3.0 Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team(2026年),通过在工业规模的Unreal-Engine和AAAA-game数据引擎上进行内存传播,针对长视一致性,释放模型重量和代码,但保持其游戏训练公司和视频-Pose-Action-Prompt四重力数据专有性,没有为扩展、放大和复制留下共享的底线。 我们的工作补充了Matrix-Game 3.0:虽然它通过一个封闭数据引擎的内存从模型侧面解决了长视距问题,GameVerse却通过一个公开发布的,多游戏的,分钟尺度的元件从数据侧面处理,任何模型都可以消耗. 湖南卫视 工艺 李等人(2025年a)和HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld(2025年)报告说,在各种环境中都取得了强劲的质量成果,但依赖于未发行的内部游戏游戏录音;WorldPlay Sun等人. (2025年)在相同的专有数据约束下追求实时长视野生成,而VMem Li等人(2025年b)则探索了Surfel-index内存,但仍与一个方法特定体相联. 在整个这一景观中,缺乏一个公开的,多样的,多游戏的,微量的游戏游戏数据集仍然是主要的瓶颈,而不是模型能力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Camera-Aware Video Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.2 摄像头视像监督

blocks.en: Explicit camera control is a key axis of controllable video generation Xu et al. (2026) . On the method side, CameraCtrl He et al. (2024b) and MotionCtrl Wang et al. (2024b) demonstrate that trajectory conditioning materially improves geometric consistency in generated video, but both rely on the data side to provide reliable trajectories for training. On the data side, ViPE Huang et al. (2025) provides scalable monocular pose estimation from unconstrained video and is the de-facto tool for retrofitting trajectories onto large video corpora; we leverage it as a tool in our pipeline rather than as a competing dataset. Among existing datasets, Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) ; He et al. (2025) ; Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team (2026) , Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) , and HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld (2025) obtain engine-level camera poses in their closed training pipelines, which are never released as supervision; Sekai Li et al. (2025c) ; He et al. (2026) ships estimated trajectories alongside long-duration walking video but does not validate them against sudden jumps, high-frequency jitter, or long-term drift, leaving its trajectories noisy in practice at the minute scale; and the bulk of general-purpose video-language datasets ship no calibrated poses at all. GameVerse instead pairs every clip with a frame-level ViPE trajectory that has passed explicit jump-, jitter-, and drift-filtering, delivering minute-scale trajectories that remain physically coherent across the full clip, and we release these trajectories openly together with the video sources.
blocks.zh: 清晰相机控制是可控视频生成徐等人(2026)的关键轴. 在方法方面,CameraCtrl He等人(2024年b)和MotionCtrl Wang等人(2024年b)证明,轨迹调节在物质上提高了生成的视频中的几何一致性,但两者都依靠数据侧为培训提供可靠的轨迹. 数据方面,VIPE Huang等. (2025年)从不受约束的视频中提供可伸缩的单面姿势估计,是将轨迹改造到大型视频公司(英语:Great video corpora)的事实上法克托工具;我们利用它作为我们管道中的工具,而不是作为相互竞争的数据集. 在现有的数据集中,Matrix-Game Zhang等人(2025);He等人(2025);Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team(2026);Hunyuan-GameCraft Li等人(2025a),以及HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld(2025)在封闭式训练管道中获取发动机级照相机,从未作为监督发布;Sekai Li等人(2025c); 他等人(2026年)的舰只估计航向与长途行走录影带并列,但对突然跳跃,高频颤抖,或长期漂移没有验证,使其航向在实际操作中在分钟尺度上产生噪音;而大部分通用视频语言数据集的舰只完全没有校准姿势. 游戏 Verse将每个剪辑与一个帧级的VIPE轨迹对齐,这些轨迹已经经过了明显的跳跃,抖动,以及漂移的过滤,传递了在全剪辑中保持物理一致性的微尺度轨迹,我们把这些轨迹和视频源一起公开发布.

blocks.en: 2.3 Structured Caption Annotations for Video
blocks.zh: 2.3 录像结构说明

blocks.en: Caption supervision drives controllable generation, but existing video datasets stop short of the structure required for long-horizon and behavior-conditioned synthesis. HowTo100M Miech et al. (2019) relies on ASR transcripts that are loosely aligned and dominated by narration rather than scene description. InternVid Wang et al. (2024a) and ActivityNet-style dense-captioning data Krishna et al. (2017) ; Heilbron et al. (2015) contribute auto-generated or sparse event captions but treat each clip as a flat sequence of events, with no separation of static scene context from dynamic foreground and no isolation of agent behavior from environmental change. MiraData Ju et al. (2024) pushes toward longer-duration video with longer structured captions, but its semantic schema is tuned to real-world video and does not include an agent-action vocabulary suitable for interactive generation. On the gameplay side, GameGen-X Che et al. (2025) provides single-line clip-level captions that conflate scene context with dynamic events, and Sekai Li et al. (2025c) similarly attaches one whole-clip description to each minute-long video; in either case the controllable channel cannot be modulated independently of the scene. Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) ; He et al. (2025) ; Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team (2026) , Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) , and HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld (2025) do not publicly release caption supervision at all. GameVerse instead annotates every clip with a four-level hierarchical schema— global static , local static , dynamic events , and agent actions —generated by a vision-language model Team et al. (2026b) and aligned to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows, so that environment context is disentangled from controllable agent behavior and can be used directly as a hierarchical conditioning signal.
blocks.zh: Caption compression驱动可控生成,但现有的视频数据集停止了长视距和行为条件合成所需的结构. 如何达到100M Miech等人(2019年)依靠ASR的笔录,这些笔录对齐松散,以叙述而不是场景描述为主. InternVid Wang et al.(2024a)和ActiveNet风格的密集封装数据Krishna et al.(2017) ;Heilbron et al.(2015) 提供了自动生成或稀少的事件标题,但将每段片段视为事件的平整序列,没有将静态场景背景与动态前缘分开,也没有将代理行为与环境变化隔离. 米拉 数据 Ju et al. blocks.en: 3 Dataset Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3 数据集建设管道

blocks.en: Existing video datasets for world modeling still exhibit limitations along three axes: fragmented temporal structure caused by short clip segmentation, unstable or absent camera pose estimation, and flat semantic annotations that conflate static context with dynamic events. To address these limitations, we design a unified data construction pipeline that takes a curated pool of long-form gameplay videos and transforms it into structured, minute-scale data units, each consisting of an aligned video segment, a validated camera trajectory, and a multi-granular caption set. The pipeline begins with a data collection step (Section 3.1 ) that builds the raw pool, followed by four processing stages: scene-consistent segmentation , multi-stage video quality evaluation (illustrated in Figure 2 ), camera pose estimation and validation , and multi-granular structured captioning . Each stage targets a specific limitation of prior gameplay datasets.
blocks.zh: 现有的用于世界建模的视频数据集仍然沿着三个轴线表现出局限性:短片片断导致的时间结构支离破碎,摄像头不稳定或缺失造成估计,平面语义说明将静态上下文与动态事件混为一谈. 为了克服这些局限性,我们设计了一个统一的数据构建管道,它需要一组长形的游戏游戏录影带,并将其转换成结构化的,分级的数据单元,每个单元都包含一个对齐的视频段,一个经过验证的相机轨迹,以及一个多角度的字幕集. 管道首先采用数据收集步骤(第3.1节),建立原始池,然后是四个处理阶段:场景一致的分区,多阶段的视频质量评价(如图2所示),照相机进行估计和验证,以及多角度结构化字幕。 每个阶段都针对前作游戏游戏数据集的特定限制.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: Constructing a long-horizon gameplay corpus at the scale GameVerse targets requires a source that is simultaneously diverse—across games, perspectives, and behaviors—and openly releasable to the community. Engine recordings used by Genie Bruce et al. (2024) , the Matrix-Game family Zhang et al. (2025) ; He et al. (2025) ; Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team (2026) , Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) , and HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld (2025) satisfy diversity within a single title but are proprietary and typically centered on one or two games. We instead build on YouTube, which is, to our knowledge, the only open source that simultaneously offers long-form gameplay recordings across many AAA and indie titles, both first- and third-person perspectives, and a wide range of player behaviors. All videos are retained at the highest available quality, up to 1080p at 30–60 FPS .
blocks.zh: 在GameVerse目标上构建一个长视距的游戏玩家体,需要一种同时多样化的来源——跨游戏、视角和行为——并公开向社区公布。 Genie Bruce et al. (2024), Matrix-Game family Zhang et al. (2025), He et al. (2025), Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team (2026), Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a), HY-World 1.5 Hunyuan World (2025)) 使用的引擎录音满足单一标题内的多样性,但具有专有性,一般集中在一两个游戏上. 相反,我们是在YouTube上建立起来的,据我们所知,这是同时提供许多AAA和Indie标题的长式游戏剧本录音,包括第一人称和第三人称视角,以及广泛的玩家行为的唯一开放源头. 所有录像都以现有最高质量保留,30-60 FPS最多保存1080p.

blocks.en: Videos are collected on a per-title basis from a curated set of open-world AAA and indie games chosen to together span both first- and third-person viewpoints. Because the chosen titles already exhibit a wide range of player activities and environments, the resulting source pool naturally covers the eight behavior categories reported in Section 4 ( exploring , combat , walking , running , driving , interacting , climbing , and idle ) together with diverse environments under varied weather, time-of-day, season, and crowd-density conditions. The collected corpus consists of 11,002 source videos , totalling 4,692 hours (195.5 days) and approximately 986.6 M frames , which the four processing stages below convert into the final 188K structured clips.
blocks.zh: 视频是按每集标题收集的,取材自一套精致的开放世界AA和Indie游戏,它们选择了跨越第一和第三人称视角的游戏。 由于所选标题已经展现了广泛的玩家活动和环境,因此由此而来的来源池自然涵盖了第4节(探索,战斗,步行,跑步,驾驶,互动,攀登,闲散)中所报告的8个行为类别,以及在不同天气,时间,季节,人群密度条件下的不同环境. 收集的内容包括11 002个原始视频,共计4 692小时(195.5天)和约986.6M帧,以下四个处理阶段转换成最终的188K结构剪辑。

blocks.en: 3.2 Scene-consistent Segmentation
blocks.zh: 3.2 场景一致的分裂

blocks.en: Existing datasets typically rely on short clips of a few seconds, which disrupt temporal continuity and limit long-horizon modeling. We start from long-form videos and explicitly construct minute-level continuous segments by removing scene transitions. We first employ TransNetV2 Soucek and Lokoc (2024) to detect abrupt scene transitions (hard cuts) based on frame-level transition probabilities. To capture gradual transitions (e.g., camera panning or UI state changes) that are difficult to capture by hard-cut detection alone, we additionally compute a CLIP-based cosine semantic distance between sampled frames, treating large jumps in semantic distance as smooth-transition boundaries. Combining hard-cut detection with semantic-change signals, we extract scene-consistent segments of up to 120 seconds, which can be further concatenated into longer sequences. After segmentation, we obtain 272,128 clips totalling 4,661 hours , among which 120-second clips contribute approximately 2,773 hours .

blocks.en: 3.3 Multi-stage Video Quality Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 多阶段视频质量评价

blocks.en: Even after scene-consistent segmentation, raw gameplay videos may still contain subtitles, watermarks, UI overlays, compression artifacts, duplicated content, and unstable temporal dynamics, all of which can introduce distracting visual signals and inconsistent supervision for world modeling. To ensure both visual fidelity and temporal coherence, we design a multi-stage video quality evaluation pipeline (Figure 2 ) that progressively performs (i) basic filtering to remove low-resolution or corrupted videos; (ii) content and quality assessment using OCR-based detection to filter subtitles, HUD elements, and other overlays; (iii) stability and UI detection to identify unstable motion patterns and temporal artifacts; (iv) deduplication and diversity selection to eliminate highly similar samples while preserving diverse gameplay scenarios; and (v) temporal refinement using temporal-quality metrics such as COVER He et al. (2024a) and VBench Huang et al. (2024) consistency scores. These complementary stages jointly address frame-level visual degradation, temporal inconsistencies, and dataset redundancy. The overall quality of each clip is computed as a weighted sum of its per-stage scores, while stage-specific constraints prevent severe quality defects from being compensated for by high scores in other dimensions. Additionally, we recover a subset of previously filtered clips where the camera remains stationary while scene content continues to evolve, preserving meaningful object and agent dynamics under fixed viewpoints for world-model training. Only clips passing the corresponding quality checks are retained. Detailed thresholds and per-stage criteria are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 即使在场景一致的分区之后,原始的游戏剧情视频仍然可能包含字幕,水印,UI重叠,压缩文物,内容重复,以及不稳定的时间动态,所有这些都可以引入分散视觉信号和不连贯的对世界模特的监督. 为确保视觉忠实和时间一致性,我们设计了一个多阶段视频质量评价管道(图2),逐步进行(一) 清除低分辨率或腐败视频的基本过滤;(二) 内容和质量评估,利用基于OCR的检测过滤字幕、HUD元素和其他覆盖物;(三) 稳定性和UI检测,以查明不稳定的运动模式和时间文物;(四) 分化和多样性选择,消除高度相似的样本,同时保留不同的游戏场景;以及(五) 利用时间质量计量,如CVER He等人(2024a)和V Bench Huang等人(2024a),对时间进行了改进。 (2024)一致性分数. 这些互补阶段共同处理帧级视觉退化、时间不一致和数据集冗余。 每个片段的总体质量按每个阶段得分的加权总和计算,而不同阶段的限制则防止严重的质量缺陷得到其他方面高分的补偿。 此外,我们回收以前过滤过的片段,在镜头保持静止的同时,场景内容继续演化,在世界模式培训的固定角度下保留有意义的物体和代理动力。 只保留通过相应质量检查的片段. 附录B规定了每个阶段的详细阈值和标准。

blocks.en: 3.4 Camera Pose Estimation and Validation
blocks.zh: 3.4 摄影机Pose估计和验证

blocks.en: Most existing datasets lack reliable camera pose information. Even when available, pose annotations are often noisy or unstable, limiting their usefulness for geometric modeling. To address this, we apply ViPE Huang et al. (2025) to estimate frame-wise camera poses for each video segment, obtaining both intrinsic and extrinsic parameters.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的数据集缺乏可靠的相机来显示信息. 即使有,姿势说明也往往很吵或不稳定,限制了其对几何模型的用处. 为了解决这一问题,我们采用VIPE Huang等人(2025年)来估计每个视频段的帧式照相机,获得内在参数和外在参数。

blocks.en: However, pose estimation in dynamic scenes is inherently challenging and often suffers from noise and tracking failures. To ensure trajectory reliability, we validate every estimated pose against three common error modes: sudden jumps (large non-physical pose changes between consecutive frames, typically from tracking failures or relocalisation errors), high-frequency jitter (local instability producing unnatural oscillations), and long-term drift (accumulated errors over time). We score each clip with a unified trajectory-quality function combining local relative-pose increments (capturing jumps and jitter) and a global trajectory smoothness term (capturing drift), and apply threshold-based filtering to remove unreliable samples.
blocks.zh: 然而,在动态场景中作出估计本身就具有挑战性,经常受到噪音和跟踪故障的影响。 为确保轨迹的可靠性,我们对照三种常见错误模式验证每个估计的姿势:突然跳跃(在连续的帧之间,主要是从跟踪故障或重新定位错误中,巨大的非物理姿势变化),高频颤抖(局部不稳定产生非自然振荡),以及长期漂移(随着时间的推移累积的错误)。 我们用一个统一的轨迹质量函数来评分每个剪辑,结合局部相对可控增量(跳跃和焦急)和全球轨迹平滑性术语(跳跃),并采用基于阈值的过滤方法去除不可靠的样本.

blocks.en: 3.5 Multi-granular Structured Captioning
blocks.zh: 3.5 多角结构说明

blocks.en: Semantic annotations in prior gameplay datasets, such as GameGen-X Che et al. (2025) and Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) , typically take the form of single-level captions or simple action labels that mix static scene context with dynamic behavior. Even structured annotations often provide limited separation across temporal and semantic scales.
blocks.zh: 在之前的游戏玩法数据集中的语义说明,如GameGen-X Che等人(2025年)和Hunyuan-GameCraft Li等人(2025a年),一般采取单级字幕或简单的动作标签的形式,将静态场景背景与动态行为混合. 即使有结构的说明也常常提供时间和语义尺度上有限的分离.

blocks.en: To capture fine-grained gameplay semantics, we introduce a multi-granular structured captioning framework for GameVerse using the vision-language model Kimi-K2.5 Team et al. (2026b) . As illustrated in Figure 1 (e.2), the framework separates static context from dynamic processes and organizes each clip’s semantics into four complementary components: global static , clip-level environment and scene context (terrain, weather, lighting, and viewpoint); local static , relatively stable scene configurations within each temporal segment (functional areas, landmarks, and visible objects); dynamic events , changes in the surrounding world (crowd movement, traffic, and environmental transitions); and agent actions , the main subject’s behavior, described using a unified action vocabulary that separates action semantics from viewpoint. Together, these components provide explicit semantic supervision at multiple granularities, supporting hierarchical and conditional generation. Annotation details and examples are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉精细的游戏游戏玩法语义,我们采用视觉语言模型Kimi-K2.5 Team et al. (2026b),为GameVerse引入了多角度结构化字幕框架. 如图1(e.2)所示,框架将静态背景与动态过程区分开来,将每个剪辑的语义组织成四个互补部分:全球静态,剪辑层次的环境和场景背景(地形,天气,照明和观点);每个时间段(功能区,地标,和可见物体)内局部静态,相对稳定的场景配置;动态事件,周边世界的变化(人群移动,交通,和环境过渡);以及代理人行为,主体行为,使用将动作语义与视角区分开来的统一动作词汇描述. 这些成分加在一起,在多个颗粒体上提供明确的语义监督,支持分级和有条件的生成. 说明的细节和实例见附录E。

blocks.en: 4 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 4 数据集统计

blocks.en: After the construction pipeline of Section 3.1 , GameVerse contains 69.7K high-quality gameplay clips totalling 1,655 hours , including 1,358 hours of two-minute continuous video. We analyse the dataset along four axes that mirror the contribution claims of Section 1 : long-horizon temporal scale (Section 4.1 ), interaction and environment diversity (Section 4.2 ), camera-trajectory diversity (Section 4.3 ), and caption annotation statistics (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 第3.1节建设管道后,GameVerse包含69.7K高品质的游戏剧情片段,共计1,655小时,包括1,358小时的2分钟连续视频. 我们按照四个轴线分析数据集,这四个轴线反映了第1节的贡献要求:长视时尺度(第4.1节)、相互作用和环境多样性(第4.2节)、相机-弹射多样性(第4.3节)和标题注释统计(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Scale and Long-Horizon Distribution
blocks.zh: 4.1 规模和长视距分布

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a) shows the clip-duration distribution of GameVerse. Unlike prior gameplay video datasets such as GameGen-X Che et al. (2025) , Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) ; He et al. (2025) ; Skywork AI Matrix-Game Team (2026) , and Hunyuan-GameCraft Li et al. (2025a) , which are dominated by clips shorter than ten seconds, GameVerse preserves substantially longer temporal continuity. Over 40.6K clips reach the 120-second upper bound and together contribute approximately 1,358 hours of continuous gameplay video, an order of magnitude longer than the continuous footage exposed in any prior gameplay corpus that we are aware of. Clips of 60 s or longer account for a further substantial portion of the dataset, providing the kind of minute-scale supervision that is essentially absent from existing gameplay corpora and is required to extend interactive world-model rollouts beyond the one-minute coherence ceiling discussed in Section 1 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Interaction and Environment Diversity
blocks.zh: 4.2 互动与环境多样性

blocks.en: GameVerse spans at least 110 distinct game titles , with the genre composition shown in panel (II) of Figure 1 . The distribution is long-tailed: the most-represented titles— God of War , Red Dead Redemption 2 , Ghost of Tsushima , Elden Ring , and The Witcher 3 —each contribute over 1,800 clips, while the tail extends across dozens of additional AAA and indie titles. Across the corpus, approximately 24% of clips are first-person, 73% are third-person follow camera, and 3% use specialised perspectives (drone, vehicle-mounted, gimbal-follow, stationary). This 1:3 first-to-third-person ratio supplies substantial supervision for both FPV and TPV settings, in sharp contrast to the Minecraft-only Matrix-Game Zhang et al. (2025) ; He et al. (2025) and to Sekai Li et al. (2025c) , which is restricted to first-person walking footage. Figure 1 also presents the distribution of player-behavior categories— exploring , combat , walking , driving , interacting , climbing , running , and idle —spanning basic locomotion to complex object interaction and high-speed vehicle control; exploring, combat, walking, and driving together contribute the largest share of total video duration. Figure 3 (b) further shows the hierarchical scene-attribute distribution: the corpus spans urban, rural, forest, highway, temple, and industrial environments under varied architectural styles, weather conditions, time-of-day, seasons, and crowd-density levels.
blocks.zh: GameVerse至少跨过110个不同的游戏标题,其流派组成在图1的面板(II)中显示. 发行时间很长:最有代表性的标题——战神,红死救赎2,鹤岛鬼魂,埃尔登环,巫师3——各贡献超过1800个片段,而片尾则延伸至另外数十个AAA和Indie标题. 在整个调查中,大约24%的片段是第一人称的,73%是第三人称的相机,3%使用专门视角(德龙、车载、 gi跟随、固定)。 这个1:3的第一对第三人称比为FPV和TPV两个设置提供了实质性的监督,与Minecraft独家的Matrix-Game Zhang等人(2025年);He等人(2025年)和Sekai Li等人(2025年c年)形成鲜明对比,后者仅限于第一人称行走镜头. 图1还介绍了玩家-行为类的分布——探索,战斗,步行,驾驶,互动,攀登,跑步,闲散——将基本运动扩展至复杂的物体交互和高速车辆控制;探索,战斗,步行,驾驶共同贡献了视频总长度的最大份额. 图3(b)进一步显示了等级的场景属性分布:在各种建筑风格、天气条件、时间、季节和人群密度水平下,人身保护横跨城市、农村、森林、公路、庙宇和工业环境。

blocks.en: 4.3 Camera Trajectory Diversity
blocks.zh: 4.3 相机轨迹多样性

blocks.en: Figure 4 (a) shows the distribution of camera-motion patterns in GameVerse. The corpus covers static , rotational , translational , and complex motions. Forward motion accounts for the largest share ( 34.7% ), reflecting the prevalence of continuous navigation and exploration in gameplay. Complex motions that couple translation with rotation contribute a further 22.0% ; these clips are particularly challenging for long-horizon world modeling because they require simultaneous geometric and identity consistency under non-trivial viewpoint change. Lateral movement, orbit motion, and mixed rotational patterns are also well represented, indicating substantial diversity along the trajectory axis. By contrast, real-world walking-video datasets such as Sekai are typically dominated by forward translation with limited rotational complexity, and gameplay datasets that obtain engine-level poses are restricted to a single title’s controller scheme. The richer camera dynamics in GameVerse therefore enable supervision for geometry-aware generation, camera-controllable video synthesis, and interactive world modeling under genuine viewpoint change.
blocks.zh: 图4(a)显示GameVerse中相机动图案的分布. 案卷包括静态、旋转、翻译和复杂的动议。 前进运动占最大份额(34.7%),反映了游戏游戏中持续导航和探索的普遍程度. 将翻译与旋转结合起来的复杂运动又贡献了22.0%;这些短片对于长视世界模型制作来说尤其具有挑战性,因为它们需要在非三角视角变化下同时进行几何和身份一致性。 横向运动、轨道运动和混合旋转模式也得到了很好的体现,表明沿轨迹轴的差别很大。 相比之下,诸如Sekai等现实世界的行走视频数据集通常以旋转复杂性有限的前传翻译为主,获得引擎级姿势的游戏游戏游戏数据集仅限于单一标题控制器方案. 因此,GameVerse中较丰富的相机动力学使得能够对几何-感知生成、相机可控视频合成以及在真正观点变化下进行互动的世界模型制作进行监督。

blocks.zh: 4.4 注释统计

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Word-cloud visualization of the four semantic caption components in GameVerse.
blocks.zh: 图5:GameVerse中四个语义标题组件的文字-云可视化.

blocks.en: Figure 4 (b) shows the caption-length distributions across the four semantic levels introduced in Section 3.5 . Local static descriptions and dynamic events are substantially longer, with median lengths of 895 and 775 characters respectively, reflecting the rich environmental structure and dynamic scene changes in gameplay video. Global static and agent action captions are more concise: global-static captions describe high-level scene context, and agent actions are drawn from a constrained vocabulary so that the controllable channel can be modulated cleanly during conditional generation. Compared to the single-line whole-clip captions of Sekai and the clip-level captions of GameGen-X, the four-level schema produces substantially more total semantic information per clip while remaining structured enough to act as a hierarchical conditioning signal.
blocks.zh: 图4(b)显示第3.5节提出的四个语义层次的标题长度分布。 局部静态描述和动态事件要长得多,中间长度分别为895和775个字符,反映了游戏播放视频中丰富的环境结构和动态场景变化. 全球静态和代理动作标题更为简洁:全局静态标题描述高阶场景背景,代理动作从受限词汇中抽取,这样在有条件生成时,可控通道可以被干净地调制. 相比于Sekai的单线全clip字幕和GameGen-X的剪辑级字幕,四级的schema在结构上保持足够的结构,以起到分级调节信号的作用的同时,每个片段产生的总语义信息要大得多.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that the four levels concentrate on largely disjoint vocabularies—scene attributes, spatial layouts, environment transitions, and explicit motion—confirming that the schema produces semantically separated annotations rather than overlapping rephrasings of the same clip.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,这四个级别主要集中于词组的脱节——场景属性、空间布局、环境过渡和明显的运动——确认计划产生同片段的分解说明而不是重叠重写。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate 60-second image-to-video generation on the same 103 inputs using LingBot Gao et al. (2026) , HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld (2025) ; Sun et al. (2025) , HY-World-FT, and LTX-FT. HY-World-FT is obtained by fine-tuning HY-World 1.5 on approximately 600 hours of GameVerse for 3,000 steps, using the step-3,000 checkpoint without changing the architecture. LTX-FT is a GameVerse-adapted LTX-Video 2.3 model Lightricks (2026) . The fixed-backbone comparison measures the benefit of additional GameVerse fine-tuning under a shared evaluation protocol; comparisons across model families characterize complete systems with different architectures and control interfaces.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Lingbot Gao等人(2026年)、HY-World 1.5 HunyuanWorld(2025年)、Sun等人(2025年)、HY-World-FT和LTX-FT,在同一103个输入上评价60秒图像到视频生成。 HY-World-FT是通过在GameVerse约600小时的3000步上微调HY-World 1.5而获得的,使用步-3000的检查站而不改变结构. LTX-FT是一个GameVerse适应的LTX-Video 2.3型号的Lightricks (2026). 固定背骨比较衡量根据共同评价协议进行额外的GameVerse微调的好处;模型家族之间的比较说明完整的系统具有不同的架构和控制接口。

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate generation performance from two complementary perspectives. Video generation quality is assessed using VBench Huang et al. (2024) across six dimensions: Subject Consistency, Background Consistency, Motion Smoothness, Aesthetic Quality, Imaging Quality, and Overall Consistency, collectively measuring temporal coherence, motion stability, visual fidelity, and text–video alignment. World generation quality and controllability are evaluated using WorldScore Duan et al. (2025) , covering camera and object control, content alignment, 3D consistency, photometric consistency, style consistency, and subjective quality. We report all seven normalized WorldScore components alongside their arithmetic mean (WS-Static). Higher scores indicate better performance across all reported metrics. Detailed definitions and evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们从两个相辅相成的角度评价世代的业绩。 V Bench Huang等人(2024年)使用V Bench Huang等人(2024年)在六个维度上评估视频生成质量:主题一致性,背景一致性,运动平滑性,审美质量,成像质量,以及整体一致性,集体测量时间一致性,运动稳定性,视觉忠诚度,以及文本–video对齐. 使用WorldScore Duan等人(2025年)来评价世界生成的质量和可控性,涵盖相机和对象控制,内容一致,3D一致性,光度一致性,风格一致性,以及主观质量. 我们报告所有七个正常的WorldScore组件及其算术平均值(WS-Static)。 得分较高表明所有报告衡量标准的业绩都较好。 详细的定义和评价规程载于附录C.1。

blocks.en: 5.3 Minute-Scale Generation Performance
blocks.zh: 5.3 分钟生成性能

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , LTX-FT achieves the best temporal consistency across 60-second rollouts, leading in Subject Consistency (79.17), Background Consistency (90.63), and Motion Smoothness (99.53). Meanwhile, LingBot performs better on perceptual quality and text–video alignment, achieving the highest Aesthetic Quality (6.14), Imaging Quality (56.70), and Overall Consistency (18.25). Notably, under the same HY-World 1.5 backbone, fine-tuning on GameVerse consistently improves all six VBench metrics. In particular, Subject Consistency increases from 66.92 to 68.45, Background Consistency from 81.77 to 83.30, and Overall Consistency from 14.48 to 15.69, demonstrating the effectiveness of GameVerse in enhancing temporal coherence and generation quality without architectural modifications.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,LTX-FT在60秒的推出中实现了最佳的时间一致性,在主题一致性(79.17)、背景一致性(90.63)和运动平滑性(99.53)。 与此同时,LingBot在视觉质量和文本-视频对齐方面表现得更好,实现了最高的审美质量(6.14)、成像质量(56.70)和总体一致性(18.25)。 值得注意的是,在同一HY-World 1.5主干线下,GameVerse的微调不断改进了所有六个V Bench 度量衡. 特别是,主题一致性从66.92提高到68.45,背景一致性从81.77提高到83.30,整体一致性从14.48提高到15.69,展示了GameVerse在不经建筑改造而提高时间一致性和生成质量方面的有效性.

blocks.en: Table 3 evaluates world generation quality and controllability. LTX-FT achieves the highest WS-Static score (59.65), leading in 3D Consistency (95.13), Photometric Consistency (98.45), and Style Consistency (90.04). LingBot performs best in Camera Control, Content Alignment, and Subjective Quality, while HY-World-FT leads in Object Control. LingBot’s stronger camera control may partly benefit from ground-truth pose supervision and dedicated conditioning mechanisms, whereas GameVerse relies on ViPE-estimated trajectories (see Appendix C.2 ). Importantly, fine-tuning the same HY-World backbone ( Hy-World-FT ) on GameVerse improves all seven WorldScore components, increasing WS-Static from 53.33 to 55.13, 3D Consistency from 66.94 to 73.42 (+6.48), and Camera Control from 28.58 to 28.90. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of GameVerse in improving geometric consistency and controllability for minute-scale generation.
blocks.zh: 表3评价了世界发电的质量和可控性。 LTX-FT实现WS-Static分数最高(59.65),领先于3D一致性(95.13),光度一致性(98.45)和Style一致性(90.04). LingBot在相机控制,内容对齐和主观质量方面表现最好,而HY-World-FT则在对象控制方面领先. 灵灵 Bot的更强的相机控制可能部分受益于地面真实性构成的监督和专用的调节机制,而GameVerse则依赖于VIPE估计的轨迹(见附录C.2). 重要的是,在GameVerse上微调相同的HY-World主干线(Hy-World-FT)可以改善所有七个WorldScore组件,WS-Static从53.33增加到55.13,3D一致性从66.94增加到73.42(+6.48),相机控制从28.58增加到28.90. 这些结果显示GameVerse在提高几何一致性和可控性以进行微尺度生成方面的效力.

blocks.en: 5.4 Long-Horizon Consistency Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 长视距一致性分析

blocks.en: To further assess long-horizon stability, we sample generated frames at 2 Hz and compute their CLIP ViT-B/32 Radford et al. (2021) similarity to the input frame. As shown in Table 4 (a), LTX-FT achieves the highest similarity at 30 seconds (0.785) and the latest reported threshold crossing (50.7s). Notably, under the same HY-World backbone, GameVerse fine-tuning improves the 30-second similarity from 0.609 to 0.642 and delays the first similarity drop below 0.6 from 30.4s to 37.9s. These results suggest improved reference preservation and reduced visual drift over extended rollouts, although viewpoint changes may also affect similarity.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评估长视距稳定性,我们在2Hz取样生成的帧,并计算其CLIP VIT-B/32 Radford等人(2021年)与输入帧相似. 如表4(a)所示,LTX-FT在30秒(0.785)和最近报告的阈值跨越(50.7秒)时达到最高相似度。 值得注意的是,在相同的HY-World主干线下,GameVerse微调改进了30秒的相似度,从0.609提高到0.642,并将第一次相似度降至0.6以下,从30.4s降到37.9s. 这些结果表明,在扩展推广过程中,参考资料保存得到改善,视觉漂移减少,尽管观点变化也可能影响相似性。

blocks.en: Table 4 (b) further evaluates Subject Consistency across four gameplay activities. LTX-FT achieves the highest scores across driving, riding, running, and walking. Under the same backbone, HY-World-FT consistently outperforms HY-World 1.5, with improvements of 1.15, 1.85, 2.49, and 1.58 points, respectively. These consistent gains across diverse gameplay activities further support the effectiveness of GameVerse for long-horizon generation.

blocks.en: 5.5 Annotation Quality Validation
blocks.zh: 5.5 说明 质量验证

blocks.en: We assess trajectory completeness and temporal stability after quality filtering, and compare ViPE estimates with an independent DROID-SLAM estimator Teed and Deng (2021) . After Sim(3) alignment, rotation RPE ranges from 0.75 to 1.47 degrees and translation-direction error from 4.84 to 11.03 degrees across six motion categories. The audited retained trajectories have complete valid poses; mixed rotation exhibits the largest cross-estimator errors. These measurements characterize consistency between two estimators, rather than absolute pose accuracy against ground truth. Full motion-wise results are provided in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们评估质量过滤后的轨迹完整性和时间稳定性,并将VIPE的估计数与独立的DROID-SLAM估算器Teed和Deng(2021)进行比较。 在Sim(3)对齐后,旋转的RPE介于0.75至1.47度之间,翻译方向错误介于4.84至11.03度之间,跨越六个运动类别. 被审计的保留轨迹有完整的有效姿势;混合旋转显示出最大的交叉估计器错误。 这些测量是两个估算器之间一致性的特点,而不是相对于地面真理的绝对准确性。 附录C.3提供了完全的动向结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Human evaluation of structured captions on 400 clips.
blocks.zh: 表5:对400个剪辑上结构化字幕的人类评价。

blocks.en: To assess the quality of our multi-granular semantic annotations, we conduct a video-grounded human evaluation on 400 clips stratified by game, viewpoint, motion type, and duration. Three independent annotators evaluate the accuracy and temporal alignment of each caption against its corresponding video. As shown in Table 5 , the annotations achieve high scores in scene/event accuracy (4.82/5) and agent-action accuracy (4.66/5), while temporal alignment (4.61/5) and camera-motion accuracy (4.55/5) also show favorable results. The overall alignment score reaches 4.64/5, with consistent judgments among annotators (Krippendorff’s α = 0.76 \alpha=0.76 ). Furthermore, the clip-level hallucination and temporal-mismatch rates are limited to 5.5% and 4.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our structured captioning pipeline in capturing fine-grained gameplay semantics, while highlighting remaining challenges in annotation accuracy and temporal alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们多角度语义说明的质量,我们用视频对400个片段进行了人类评价,按游戏、视角、运动类型和持续时间进行分级。 三名独立的注释员对照其相应的视频,评估每个标题的准确性和时间一致性。 如表5所示,说明在场景/活动准确度(4.82/5)和代理动作准确度(4.66/5)方面都取得了很高的分数,而时间对齐度(4.61/5)和相机运动精度(4.55/5)也显示出有利的结果。 总体比分达到4.64/5,在注释者中判断一致(Krippendorff的α=0.76\alpha=0.76). 此外,短片级的幻觉和时间差异率分别限于5.5%和4.0%。 这些结果表明,我们结构化的标题管道在捕捉精细的游戏游戏游戏语义方面是有效的,同时突出了在注释准确度和时间一致性方面仍然存在的挑战。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: We present GameVerse , a minute-scale gameplay dataset for long-horizon interactive world modeling, comprising 69.7K clips totaling 1,655 hours , including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute gameplay. Built through a unified pipeline, GameVerse provides quality-filtered frame-level camera trajectories and multi-granular structured captions, jointly capturing long-term scene evolution, camera motion, and fine-grained interaction dynamics. Experiments on 60-second generation demonstrate improvements in temporal coherence, geometric consistency, and visual quality, with same-backbone comparisons further validating the benefits of GameVerse fine-tuning. Additional annotation-quality assessments support the reliability of its semantic and geometric supervision. We envision GameVerse as a valuable resource for advancing long-horizon interactive world modeling and enabling more coherent, controllable, and persistent virtual worlds.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GameVerse,是用于长视界互动世界建模的分钟级游戏游戏游戏数据集,包含69.7K片段,共计1,655小时,包括1,358小时连续两分钟的游戏游戏. GameVerse通过统一的管道建造,提供质量过滤的帧级相机轨迹和多角结构的字幕,联合捕获长期场景演化,相机运动,精细的相互作用动力学. 60秒的实验显示时间一致性,几何一致性,视觉质量都有提高,同背骨比较进一步验证了GameVerse微调的好处. 额外的注释质量评估支持其语义和几何监督的可靠性. 我们设想GameVerse是一个宝贵的资源,用于推进长视野互动的世界模型建设,并促成更加连贯、可控和持久的虚拟世界。

blocks.en: GameVerse focuses on gameplay environments, with cross-domain generalization to real-world scenarios remaining unexplored. Despite multi-stage validation, estimated camera trajectories and generated captions may retain residual errors. Continuous clips are limited to two minutes, while generation experiments cover up to 60 seconds, leaving longer rollouts and closed-loop interaction for future work. Moreover, the individual contributions of clip duration, camera supervision, and structured captions remain to be isolated, and large-scale data construction is computationally intensive.
blocks.zh: GameVerse专注于游戏游戏环境,跨域泛化到现实世界的情景仍然没有得到探讨. 尽管进行了多阶段验证,估计的相机轨迹和生成的字幕仍可能保留剩余错误. 连续片段限时2分钟,而生成实验覆盖长达60秒,为未来工作留下较长的展开和闭路交互. 此外,剪辑时间、摄像监督以及结构化标题的个别贡献仍有待孤立,大规模的数据构建在计算上是密集的。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: We fine-tune LTX-Video 2.3 (22B parameters) from the official base checkpoint on a curated GameVerse subset of 24,380 game-video segments (12–15 s each) at 540p / 24 fps . Since GameVerse targets visual interactive world modeling, we remove the audio branch of LTX-Video 2.3 prior to fine-tuning and train only the video stream. Training uses a mixed objective with weights 60% image-to-video (i2v), 20% video-to-video (v2v), and 20% text-to-video (t2v), runs for 3,700 steps at batch size 1 per GPU under FSDP across 64 GPUs . Camera conditioning is provided by additive Plücker injection and action conditioning by 81-class direction-angle embeddings . We optimise with AdamW at learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} on a constant schedule with a 200-step warmup, and retain the base model’s RoPE ( max_pos = =\, 20) under fractional-position normalisation so that all training samples remain within the position range seen during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们从官方基地检查站对LTX-Video 2.3(22B参数)进行微调,在GameVerse的24,380个游戏视频片段(每段12–15秒)的编曲下,在540p / 24 fps. 由于GameVerse的目标是视觉互动世界建模,所以在微调之前,我们删除了LTX-Video 2.3的音频分支,只训练视频流. 训练使用混合目标,在FSDP下每GPU分批3,700步,每批1次,每批64个GPU。 相机调节由添加剂Plücker注射和动作调节由81级方向角嵌入提供. 我们以学习速度1×10−4 1\time 10×4}在200步热身的恒定时间表上与AdamW进行优化,并将基型的ROPE(最大-pos = =\,20)保留在分位位置正常化下,以便所有训练样本都保持在预训期间所看到的位置范围内。

blocks.en:
To support large-scale data construction, we optimize each stage of the GameVerse pipeline for high-throughput processing.
For scene-consistent segmentation, we adopt FFmpeg with NVENC acceleration, which significantly improves video decoding and preprocessing efficiency. Combined with TransNetV2, the segmentation pipeline achieves a processing throughput of approximately 400 FPS per worker.
For camera trajectory estimation, we employ a distributed ViPE inference pipeline deployed on 256 GPUs.
On average, pose estimation for each gameplay video requires approximately 6 minutes, enabling scalable processing of long-duration videos.
For structured semantic annotation, we deploy Kimi-K2.5 using the SGLang inference framework on H20 90GB GPUs.
The caption generation stage is executed on 16 compute nodes with a total of 128 GPUs, allowing efficient large-scale generation of multi-granular semantic annotations.
blocks.zh:
为了支持大规模的数据构建,我们优化了GameVerse管道的每个阶段,用于高通量处理.
对于场景一致的分区,我们采用与NVENC加速度的FFmpeg,这大大提高了视频解码和预处理效率. 与TransNetV2相结合,分离管道的加工吞吐量约为每个工人400 FPS。
对于相机轨迹估计,我们使用256GPU上部署的分布式维PE推导管.
平均来说,每部游戏剧情视频的场景估计需要约6分钟,从而能够对长时期视频进行可扩展处理.
对于结构化的语义注释,我们使用H20 90GB GPU上的SGLang推论框架部署Kimi-K2.5.
字幕生成阶段在16个计算节点上执行,总计128 GPU,允许高效的大规模生成多格的语义注释.

blocks.en: Appendix B Detailed Multi-stage Video Quality Assessment Pipeline
blocks.zh: 附录B 多阶段视频质量评估管道

blocks.en: Even after segmentation, raw gameplay clips often contain undesirable artifacts such as subtitles, watermarks, UI overlays, compression noise, and unstable motion. These artifacts introduce spurious correlations and degrade temporal consistency, which are particularly harmful for world modeling. To address this, we design a multi-stage quality assessment pipeline with explicit criteria and calibrated thresholds, jointly considering visual quality, content cleanliness, and temporal stability.
blocks.zh: 即使在分割后,原始的游戏游戏片段也往往包含字幕,水印,UI重叠,压缩噪音,以及不稳定的动作等不良文物. 这些文物引入了虚假的关联,并降解了时间一致性,这对世界建模特别有害. 为了解决这一问题,我们设计了一个具有明确标准和校准阈值的多阶段质量评估管道,共同考虑视觉质量、内容清洁性和时间稳定性。

blocks.en: We define the overall quality of a video clip x x as a weighted combination of multiple metrics: Q ⁡ ( x ) = ∑ k w k ⋅ q k ​ ( x ) , Q(x)=\sum_{k}w_{k}\cdot q_{k}(x), (1) where q k ​ ( x ) q_{k}(x) denotes the k k -th quality metric and w k w_{k} is its corresponding weight. In practice, we adopt a hybrid strategy that combines hard constraints with soft scoring, ensuring both strict filtering and relative ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们定义一个视频剪辑Xx的整体质量是多个度量衡的加权组合:QQ(x) = ∑k k k q k(x),Q(x) sum_{k}w_{k}\cdot q_{k}(x),(1) qk(x) q_{k}(x) 表示k kk−第1个度量衡和k wk_{k}是其相应的量度. 在实践中,我们采取混合策略,将硬约束与软评分相结合,确保严格过滤和相对排名.

blocks.en: We first evaluate low-level visual properties to remove clips with obvious degradation. Specifically, we require all clips to satisfy a minimum resolution of 720p, frame rate within [ 24 , 65 ] [24,65] fps, and valid encoding formats (e.g., H.264, HEVC, or AV1). We further compute luminance using the BT.601 standard on frames sampled at 5 fps, and discard clips that contain prolonged underexposed or overexposed segments, defined as more than 15 consecutive frames with luminance below 16 or above 240. In addition, we detect border artifacts such as letterboxing and pillarboxing by measuring pixel variance along image boundaries; regions with standard deviation below 4.0 are treated as uniform borders, and clips are removed if such regions occupy more than 10% of the frame.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价低级视觉特性,去除明显退化的片段. 具体来说,我们要求所有剪辑都满足720p的最低分辨率,[24,65] [24,65] fps内的帧速率,以及有效的编码格式(如H.264,HEVC,或AV1). 我们进一步利用在5英尺处取样的帧上的BT.601标准计算亮度,并计算含有长期暴露不足或过度暴露的片段的丢弃片段,其定义是超过15个连续帧,亮度低于16或超过240。 此外,我们通过测量图像边界上的像素差异,检测到信箱和界桩等边界文物;标准偏差低于4.0的区域作为统一边界处理,如果这些区域占框的10%以上,则删除剪辑。

blocks.en: To eliminate non-world signals, we explicitly filter out text overlays and UI elements. We apply OCR-based detection to identify subtitles and watermarks, focusing on the lower portion of the frame ( y ∈ [ 0.7 , 1.0 ] y\in[0.7,1.0] ). Text regions that persist across multiple frames or occupy more than 2% of the image area trigger rejection, with a minimum detectable text height ratio of 0.008 to capture small HUD elements. In addition, we detect UI overlays based on their temporal stability and spatial structure. Specifically, we compute the temporal standard deviation σ t \sigma_{t} , mean intensity μ t \mu_{t} , and spatial gradient magnitude | ∇ I | |\nabla I| for each pixel, and identify UI regions as those satisfying ( σ t < 4 ) ∧ ( μ t > 25 ) ∧ ( | ∇ I | > 12 ) (\sigma_{t}<4)\land(\mu_{t}>25)\land(|\nabla I|>12) . Clips with UI coverage exceeding 4% are removed. This step is crucial to prevent models from overfitting to game-specific interface signals.
blocks.zh: 为了消除非世界信号,我们明确过滤文本覆盖和UI元素. 我们使用基于OCR的检测来识别字幕和水印,关注帧的下部(y QQ [0.7,1.0] y\in [0.7,1.0]). 文本区域长期跨越多个框架或占据超过2%的图像区域触发拒绝,最小可探测文本高度比为0.008,以捕捉小HUD元素. 此外,我们根据其时间稳定性和空间结构检测UI重叠. 具体地说,我们计算每个像素的时间标准偏差 \ t \ sigma_{t , 平均强度 μ t \ mütt , 和空间梯度级 \ i \ \ \ Nabla I \\ , 并确定UI 区域为可满足( \ t < 4 ) \ \ = ( μ t > 25) \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 12 ) (\ sigma_{t \ 4)\ 兰( \ mu_{t\ 25)\ 土地( Nabla) IQQ12). UI覆盖率超过4%的剪贴被移除. 这一步骤对于防止模型过度适应游戏特定界面信号至关重要.

blocks.en: We then evaluate whether clips exhibit stable and physically plausible dynamics. Motion is estimated using optical flow (Farneback) at 4 fps, where frames with mean flow magnitude below 0.3 are considered static; clips with more than 50% such frames are discarded. We further detect freezing artifacts by measuring frame-to-frame luminance differences: consecutive frames with differences below 0.5 are marked as frozen, and clips are rejected if freezing persists for more than approximately 2 seconds or exceeds 30% of the clip. To capture unstable camera motion, we analyze displacement statistics within sliding windows and identify jitter spikes when instantaneous motion exceeds five times the local mean; clips with more than four such spikes per minute are filtered out.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们评价片段是否呈现出稳定、实际可行的动态。 运动用光学流(Farneback)在4 fps进行估计,其中平均流度低于0.3的帧被认为是静态的;这种帧超过50%的片段被丢弃. 我们通过测量帧对帧的亮度差异来进一步检测冻结文物:连续帧的亮度差异低于0.5被标记为冻结,如果持续冻结超过约2秒或超过剪切的30%,则会拒绝剪切。 为了捕捉到不稳定的相机运动,我们分析滑动窗口内的移动统计数据,并在瞬间运动超过当地平均值5倍时识别焦急的突起;每分钟超过4个此类突起的片段被过滤掉。

blocks.en: Beyond these rule-based filters, we incorporate learned quality metrics. We compute multi-dimensional quality scores using COVER, including semantic, technical, and aesthetic components, and retain only the top 70% of clips ranked by the sum of aesthetic and technical scores. We further evaluate temporal consistency using VBench [ 12 ] metrics, including subject consistency, background consistency, and temporal flickering, with thresholds set to 0.65, 0.85, and 0.83 respectively.
blocks.zh: 除了这些有章可循的过滤器之外,我们纳入了学到的质量衡量标准。 我们使用 COVER 计算多维质量分数,包括语义、技术和美学成分, 并且只保留以美学和技术分数之和排名前70%的剪辑。 我们进一步使用V Bench [12] 度量标准评估时间一致性,包括主题一致性、背景一致性和时间闪烁,阈值分别定为0.65、0.85和0.83。

blocks.en: The final decision integrates all criteria. Hard constraints (e.g., format validity, OCR detection, UI filtering, motion and freeze rejection) ensure that low-quality samples are strictly removed, while soft scoring mechanisms (e.g., COVER ranking and VBench thresholds) provide finer-grained quality control. Only clips that satisfy all constraints and exceed the required thresholds are retained.
blocks.zh: 最后决定包含所有标准。 硬性约束(如格式有效性,OCR检测,UI过滤,运动和冻结拒绝)确保严格移除低质量的样本,而软性评分机制(如COVER排名和V Bench阈值)则提供更精细的刻度质量控制. 仅保留满足所有约束并超过规定阈值的片段.

blocks.en: This multi-stage pipeline yields a dataset with high visual clarity, clean semantic content, and stable temporal dynamics. Compared to simple filtering strategies, it provides a more robust and comprehensive quality control mechanism, which is essential for training reliable and generalizable world models.
blocks.zh: 这种多阶段的管道产生一个具有高度视觉清晰度、干净的语义内容和稳定的时间动态的数据集。 与简单的过滤战略相比,它提供了一个更有力和全面的质量控制机制,这对于培训可靠和可概括的世界模式至关重要。

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Experimental Details and Analyses
blocks.zh: 附录C 实验细节和分析

blocks.en: C.1 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: C.1 评价计量

blocks.en: We adopt six evaluation dimensions from VBench [ 12 ] to assess temporal consistency, perceptual quality, and semantic alignment of generated videos. Subject Consistency measures the stability of subject appearance across frames using DINO feature similarity, capturing identity drift and unintended changes in visual attributes. Background Consistency evaluates scene-level coherence through CLIP feature similarity, reflecting whether background structures remain visually consistent over time. Motion Smoothness assesses the temporal continuity of generated motion using a video frame interpolation model, penalizing abrupt or unnatural transitions. For frame-level quality, Aesthetic Quality measures visual appeal using the LAION aesthetic predictor, considering aspects such as composition and color harmony, while Imaging Quality employs MUSIQ to evaluate visual distortions, including blur, noise, and overexposure. Finally, Overall Consistency measures semantic and stylistic alignment between generated videos and their textual descriptions using ViCLIP. Together, these metrics characterize complementary aspects of video generation quality, particularly temporal coherence and visual fidelity over extended rollouts.
blocks.zh: 我们从V Bench [12] 通过六个评价层面来评估时间一致性,视觉质量,以及生成的视频的语义一致性. 主题一致性用DINO特征的相似性测量对象跨帧外观的稳定性,捕捉身份漂移和视觉属性的意外变化. 背景一致性通过CLIP特征相似评价场景层面的一致性,反映背景结构在一段时间内是否保持视觉一致性. 动议 平滑度利用视频帧插图模型评估生成运动的时间连续性,惩罚突然或非自然的过渡. 对于帧级质量,美学质量用LAION美学预测器测量视觉吸引力,考虑成分和色彩和谐等各个方面,而成像质量则使用MUSIQ来评价视觉扭曲,包括模糊,噪音,以及过度曝光. 最后,总体一致性用VICLIP测量生成的视频与其文字描述之间的语义和语义一致. 这些衡量标准加在一起,是视频生成质量的互补方面,尤其是时间一致性和视觉忠诚度相对于扩展推出。

blocks.en: We further employ WorldScore [ 4 ] to evaluate world generation quality and controllability from geometric, semantic, and perceptual perspectives. The benchmark includes three controllability metrics and four quality metrics. Camera Control measures adherence to the target camera trajectory by comparing estimated camera poses from generated videos with the prescribed motion, incorporating scale-invariant rotation and translation errors. Object Control evaluates whether prompt-specified objects appear in generated scenes using open-set object detection, while Content Alignment measures semantic agreement with the complete input description using CLIPScore. For generation quality, 3D Consistency evaluates geometric stability across frames through reprojection errors based on DROID-SLAM reconstruction. Photometric Consistency assesses the stability of visual appearance and textures using forward–backward optical-flow consistency, capturing artifacts such as texture shifts and flickering. Style Consistency evaluates whether the visual style remains consistent by comparing feature Gram matrices across generated frames. Finally, Subjective Quality estimates perceptual quality through an automatic combination of CLIP-IQA+ and CLIP Aesthetic scores, rather than direct human ratings.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步利用WorldScore[4]从几何、语义和观念的角度评价世界一代的质量和可控性。 基准包括三个可控度量衡和四个质量度量衡。 相机控制通过将生成的视频产生的估计相机与规定的运动进行对比,纳入比例不变量旋转和翻译错误,来测量对目标相机轨迹的坚持度. 对象控制(Object Control)使用开集对象检测,评价是否在生成的场景中出现即时指定对象,而内容对齐计量语义协议则使用CLIPScore进行完整的输入描述. 对于生成质量,3D一致性通过基于DROID-SLAM重建的重排错误来评价跨帧几何稳定性. 光度一致性评估视觉外观和纹理的稳定性,采用前向后向光流一致性,捕获纹理变化和闪烁等文物。 风格一致性通过在生成的帧中比较特征Gram矩阵来评价视觉风格是否仍然一致. 最后,主观质量通过CLIP-IQA+和CLIP美学分数的自动组合来估计知觉质量,而不是直接给人类评分.

blocks.en: C.2 Camera-Pose Supervision Sources
blocks.zh: C.2 摄像头监督源

blocks.en: LingBot-World [ 5 ] adopts a hybrid data engine combining general videos, synchronized game recordings, and synthetic Unreal Engine (UE) rendering. Game recordings provide temporally aligned visual observations, user actions, and camera parameters, while UE-rendered sequences offer ground-truth camera intrinsics and extrinsics. For general videos lacking camera annotations, LingBot employs MegaSAM to estimate camera poses. Its camera-conditioning mechanism further incorporates continuous camera information through Plücker embeddings for fine-grained viewpoint control.
blocks.zh: LingBot-World [5] 采用了混合数据引擎,结合了一般视频,同步游戏录音,以及合成不真实引擎(UE)渲染. 游戏录音提供时空对齐的视觉观察,用户动作,和相机参数,而UE-reserved sequences则提供地面真实相机的内在和外延. 对于没有摄像头说明的一般视频,LingBot雇佣了Mega SAM来估计相机的姿势. 它的相机调制机制进一步通过Plücker嵌入法将连续的相机信息纳入精细透视控制.

blocks.en: HY-World 1.5 [ 13 , 24 ] constructs its training corpus from approximately 320K clips, including 170K AAA-game recordings, 60K reconstructed scenes from DL3DV, 50K synthetic UE-rendered sequences, and 40K real-world videos from Sekai. The UE-rendered subset provides ground-truth camera trajectories, while the DL3DV subset uses 3D reconstruction and customized trajectory rendering for geometrically consistent supervision. For videos without available camera poses, ViPE is used for trajectory estimation and subsequent motion-consistency filtering. HY-World thus combines rendered, reconstruction-derived, and estimated trajectories with dedicated camera-conditioning mechanisms.
blocks.zh: HY-World 1.5 [13,24]从大约320K的剪辑中构筑出它的训练套装,包括170K AAA游戏录音,60K从DL3DV重建的场景,50K合成UE手动序列,以及来自Sekai的40K真实世界视频. UE-递归子集提供了地面真实相机轨迹,而DL3DV子集则使用3D重建以及定制的轨迹渲染来进行几何一致性的监理. 对于没有可用相机姿势的视频,VIPE用于轨迹估计和随后的运动一致性过滤. HY-World因此将渲染、重建、估计轨迹与专用照相机空调机制结合起来。

blocks.en: Unlike these systems, GameVerse primarily collects natural gameplay recordings without direct access to game-engine camera parameters. Camera trajectories are recovered using ViPE and subjected to multi-stage quality filtering to remove abrupt jumps, jitter, and unreliable motion. While estimated trajectories lack the precision guarantees of engine-rendered ground truth, they enable scalable coverage of diverse gameplay motions, including irregular navigation, coupled translation and rotation, and complex viewpoint transitions. Therefore, differences in camera-control performance may reflect both pose-supervision sources and conditioning architectures. Nevertheless, improvements from HY-World 1.5 to HY-World-FT demonstrate the utility of GameVerse’s estimated trajectories for geometric supervision.
blocks.zh: 与这些系统不同,GameVerse主要收集自然游戏游戏录音,而不直接访问游戏引擎相机参数. 相机轨迹利用VIPE进行回收,并经过多级质量过滤,以去除突然跳跃,焦急,不可靠的运动. 虽然估计的轨迹缺乏引擎交接地面真伪的精确保证,但能够对不同的游戏游戏动作进行可伸缩覆盖,包括不规则导航,结合翻译和旋转,以及复杂的视角过渡. 因此,相机控制性能的差异可能既反映姿势监督源,也反映调制结构. 然而,从HY-World 1.5到HY-World-FT的改进表明了GameVerse估计轨迹对几何监督的效用.

blocks.en: C.3 Camera-Trajectory Reliability by Motion Type
blocks.zh: C.3 按运动类型分列的相机-轨迹可靠性

blocks.en: To assess the reliability of GameVerse’s estimated trajectories, we evaluate pose completeness, temporal stability, and cross-estimator agreement across six camera-motion categories: forward, lateral, orbit, tilt, mixed rotation, and complex motion. As shown in Table 6 , all audited retained trajectories contain valid poses throughout their duration, with generally low jump rates and rotational jerk. We further compare ViPE trajectories against an independent DROID-SLAM estimator after Sim(3) alignment. Rotation RPE ranges from 0.75 to 1.47 degrees, while translation-direction error ranges from 4.84 to 11.03 degrees, with mixed rotation exhibiting the largest errors. These results support the temporal stability and cross-estimator consistency of the retained trajectories, although they do not establish absolute pose accuracy without ground-truth trajectories. The reported 100% valid-pose ratios refer to the retained audit set rather than all raw source videos.
blocks.zh: 为了评估GameVerse估计轨迹的可靠性,我们评价了六类相机运动的完整性、时间稳定性和跨估计器协议:前进、横向、轨道、倾斜、混合旋转和复杂的运动。 如表6所示,所有经审计的保留轨迹在整个期间都包含有效的姿势,跳跃率普遍较低,而且自转的混蛋。 我们进一步将VIPE轨迹比作Sim(3)对齐后独立的DROID-SLAM估计器. 旋转的RTE在0.75到1.47度之间,而翻译方向错误在4.84到11.03度之间,混合旋转表现出最大的错误. 这些结果支持保留轨迹的时间稳定性和跨估计一致性,尽管在没有地面真实轨迹的情况下,这些结果并不能确定绝对的准确性。 所报告的100%的有效持有比率是指保留的审计集,而不是所有原始视频。

blocks.en: Table 6: Trajectory quality across six motion types after filtering. Rotation RPE and translation-direction error are computed against DROID-SLAM after Sim(3) alignment. They measure cross-estimator agreement, not ground-truth accuracy. Jump and jerk columns reproduce the source statistics.
blocks.zh: 表6:过滤后6种运动类型的轨迹质量. 在Sim(3)对齐后,对照DROID-SLAM计算RPE旋转和翻译方向错误。 它们测量的是交叉估算器协议,而不是地面真实性。 跳跃和混蛋列复制源统计数据.

blocks.en: C.4 Diagnostic Comparison of Original Backbones
blocks.zh: C.4 原骨的诊断比较

blocks.en: To examine the influence of backbone architectures, we compare the original Wan2.2 and LTX-Video 2.3 models without camera conditioning or GameVerse fine-tuning at 5-, 10-, and 15-second generation durations. Both models use the same 103 input images and captions, a resolution of 1024 × 576 1024\times 576 , seed 42, 40 sampling steps, and a single-stage, full-resolution, non-distilled pipeline. Their native frame rates differ (16 fps for Wan2.2 and 24 fps for LTX-Video 2.3), which may affect motion-dependent metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了检查骨干架构的影响,我们比较了最初的Wan2.2和LTX-Video 2.3型号,没有相机调节或GameVerse微调,在5-,10,15-秒的一代持续时间. 两个模型都使用相同的103个输入图像和标题,一个分辨率为1024×576 1024\time576,种子42,40个采样步骤,以及一个单级,全分辨率,不蒸发的管道. 其本土帧率不同(Wan2.2为16英尺,LTX-Video为2.3为24英尺),可能影响运动依赖度量衡.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , Wan2.2 consistently achieves higher aesthetic and imaging quality across all three durations, with average advantages of 1.87 and 11.64 points, respectively. These results suggest that appearance-related performance differences between LingBot and LTX-FT may partly originate from their underlying backbones rather than GameVerse fine-tuning alone. However, this diagnostic does not isolate the causes of cross-model differences in 60-second generation. The controlled comparison between HY-World 1.5 and HY-World-FT in the main text provides more direct evidence of the benefits of GameVerse.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,Wan2.2在所有三个期间始终实现更高的审美和成像质量,平均优势分别为1.87分和11.64分。 这些结果表明,LingBot和LTX-FT之间与外观相关的性能差异可能部分源于其基础骨干,而不是光是GameVerse微调. 然而,这种诊断并没有在60秒的代中孤立出跨模型差异的原因. 主文中HY-World 1.5和HY-World-FT的控制比较更直接地证明了GameVerse的好处.

blocks.en: Appendix E Four-level Structured Semantic Annotations
blocks.zh: 附录E 四级结构语义说明

blocks.en:
To better support long-horizon interactive world modeling, GameVerse introduces a four-level structured semantic annotation framework that explicitly decomposes gameplay videos into complementary semantic components.
Unlike conventional video captions that describe an entire clip using a single sentence, our annotations separately model global static , local static , dynamic events , and agent actions , enabling more structured supervision for controllable generation and temporal world understanding.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地支持长视互动世界建模,GameVerse引入了四级结构化语义注释框架,明确将游戏游戏视频分解为互补语义组件.
与使用单句描述整个片段的常规视频字幕不同,我们的说明分别模拟全球静态、局部静态、动态事件和代理动作,

blocks.en:
Figure 7 summarizes the overall annotation format of GameVerse.
Each gameplay video is first associated with global metadata describing environmental conditions, camera properties, and high-level scene semantics.
The video is then divided into temporally aligned segments, where each segment contains structured annotations for local scene structure, dynamic events, interaction behaviors, environmental evolution, and natural-language scene descriptions.

图7概述了GameVerse的总体注释格式.
每个游戏游戏视频首先与描述环境条件的全球元数据,相机属性,以及高级场景语义相关联.
随后视频分为时间对齐的片段,其中每个片段包含对局部场景结构,动态事件,互动行为,环境演化,以及自然语言场景描述的结构化说明.

blocks.en:
The first level focuses on globally consistent environmental properties throughout the video sequence.
These annotations describe high-level scene attributes such as environment type, architectural style, weather conditions, lighting conditions, season, camera perspective, and overall scene composition.
As shown in Tables 8 – 10 , the annotations cover highly diverse environments including historical Middle Eastern cities, rocky desert landscapes, coastal ruins, underground caves, and large-scale natural environments.
Such annotations provide stable world-level context and coarse-grained environmental priors for long-horizon generation.
blocks.zh:
第一个层面侧重于整个视频序列中全球一致的环境特性。
这些说明描述了高层场景属性,如环境类型,建筑风格,天气条件,照明条件,季节,镜头视角,以及整体场景构成.
如表8 – 10所示,说明涵盖了高度多样化的环境,包括历史悠久的中东城市,多岩石的沙漠景观,海岸废墟,地下洞穴,以及大规模自然环境.
这种说明为长距发电提供了稳定的世界范围背景和粗糙的环境前身。

blocks.en:
The second level captures fine-grained spatial structures within temporally aligned segments.
Compared with global context annotations, this level focuses on local scene layouts and environment details that evolve over time.
For example, the annotations explicitly describe transitions between covered stone arcades, narrow residential streets, open plazas, cave tunnels, lakeside shorelines, and underground grotto environments.
These local structural descriptions preserve spatial continuity and geometric organization across long-duration gameplay sequences.
blocks.zh:
第二层捕捉时间对齐的片段内的细纹空间结构.
与全局背景说明相比,这一级别侧重于随时间演变的局部场景布局和环境细节.
例如,说明中明确描述了被覆盖的石拱廊、狭窄的住宅街道、开放的广场、洞穴隧道、湖边海岸线和地下沟渠环境之间的过渡。
这些局部结构描述保留了空间连续性和几何组织跨越长时期的游戏游戏序列.

blocks.en:
The third level models temporally evolving events and environmental transitions.
Instead of only describing static scenes, the annotations explicitly capture scene evolution over time, including entering enclosed caves, exiting urban districts, approaching environmental landmarks, navigating through crowded markets, and transitioning between indoor and outdoor environments.
As illustrated in the examples, GameVerse also captures environmental events such as lightning flashes, motion changes, and camera-view transitions, enabling richer supervision for temporal causality and long-horizon scene evolution.
blocks.zh:
第三级模拟时间演变的事件和环境过渡。
说明不仅描述了静态场景,还明确反映了场景随时间演变,包括进入封闭的洞穴,退出市区,接近环境地标,通过拥挤的市场航行,以及室内和室外环境之间的过渡.
如例子所示,GameVerse还捕捉到闪电闪光,运动变化,相机-视觉过渡等环境事件,从而能够对时间因果关系和长视场景演化进行更丰富的监督.

blocks.en:
The fourth level focuses on interaction-centric behaviors of the player character and surrounding agents.
These annotations describe actions such as walking, exploration, climbing, stealth movement, driving, environmental interaction, and NPC activities.
For example, the examples include navigating crowded urban streets, traversing cave systems, approaching historical landmarks, and exploring large-scale outdoor environments.
Compared with conventional action labels, the proposed annotations jointly model both the action itself and its surrounding interaction context, enabling richer supervision for controllable interaction modeling and embodied world simulation.
blocks.zh:
第四关主要关注玩家角色和周围代理人的互动中心行为.
这些说明描述了步行,探索,攀登,隐形动作,驾驶,环境互动,以及NPC活动等动作.
例如,例子包括导航拥挤的城市街道,穿梭洞穴系统,接近历史地标,探索大规模户外环境.
与传统动作标签相比,拟议说明共同模拟动作本身及其周围的相互作用背景,从而能够对可控制的相互作用模型进行更丰富的监督,并体现世界模拟。

blocks.en: Together, these four semantic levels provide complementary supervision signals for long-horizon video understanding and generation. By explicitly separating global context, local structure, dynamic events, and interaction behaviors, GameVerse provides substantially richer annotations than conventional flat captioning approaches and better supports controllable interactive world modeling.
blocks.zh: 这四个语义层面共同为长视视频理解和生成提供了辅助性监督信号. GameVerse通过明确区分全球背景,局部结构,动态事件,以及互动行为,提供了比传统平面字幕方法更丰富的说明,并更好地支持可控互动世界建模.

For example, the model successfully preserves environmental geometry and spatial layouts in large-scale outdoor exploration scenes, while maintaining smooth camera transitions and consistent illumination changes in urban streets, horseback riding, and nighttime driving scenarios.
